lines.en: Even roller coasters, Without them clocks stop ticking, Without them lights go out!
lines.zh: 就连过山车也一样，没有它们时钟就会停摆，没有它们灯光就会熄灭！

lines.en: But if you meet a Fixie, please, Don't let their secret out!
lines.zh: 但如果你遇到了修理工，千万别泄露他们的秘密！

lines.en: Nolik's Cube
lines.zh: 诺利克的魔方

lines.en: Tom Thomas, you'll be late for school if you don't stop!
lines.zh: 如果你不停下来，上学就要迟到了。

lines.en: School? Don't you worry. What's he breaking this time?
lines.zh: 别担心，他这次又弄坏了什么？

lines.en: This time nothing. He's solving a Rubik's Cube, Nolik.
lines.zh: 这次什么也没弄坏，他在解魔方。不

lines.en: Whose cube is it?
lines.zh: 看看是谁的魔方！

lines.en: The Rubik's Cube is the most popular puzzle game in the whole world.
lines.zh: 魔方是全世界最流行的益智游戏

lines.en: It was invented by Professor Rubik from Hungary.
lines.zh: 它是由匈牙利的鲁比克教授发明的。

lines.en: A cube has six sides on it.
lines.zh: 一个立方体有六个面

lines.en: And on a Rubik's Cube each of these sides
lines.zh: 魔方的每个面

lines.en: has nine squares that are all the same color.
lines.zh: 都有九个颜色相同的小方块。

lines.en: You start by mixing up the colors.
lines.zh: 解魔方时，你需要先把颜色混合在一起

lines.en: To solve a Rubik's Cube you have to turn the pieces,
lines.zh: 然后转动这些方块

lines.en: and you keep turning and turning them
lines.zh: 一直转啊转

lines.en: until each side is one solid color again.
lines.zh: 直到每个面都变成一种单一的颜色

lines.en: For instance, red or yellow or light blue.
lines.zh: 比如红色、黄色或浅蓝色。

lines.en: Ha! That's nothing! Hey, Tom Thomas!
lines.zh: 这没什么。嘿，汤姆，托马斯

lines.en: How long have you been messing around with this cube already?
lines.zh: 你玩这个魔方多久了？

lines.en: It's been three whole days of turning. Three whole days?
lines.zh: 已经转了整整三天了！整整三天！

lines.en: We could solve that puzzle in five minutes, now couldn't we, Simka?
lines.zh: 我们五分钟就能解开这个谜题，对吧？辛卡：哦

lines.en: Oh, really? Then go right ahead. I'm off to school.
lines.zh: 真的吗？那就开始吧，我要去上学了。

lines.en: Well, you ready to show Tom Thomas who's boss?
lines.zh: 你准备好让汤姆·托马斯见识一下谁才是老大了吗？

lines.en: Just count me out!
lines.zh: 别指望我了。

lines.en: Hey, I thought you said Rubik's cubes are easy to solve!
lines.zh: 嘿，你不是说魔方很容易解吗？

lines.en: I never said anything like that!
lines.zh: 我可没说过那样的话。

lines.en: This problem is all yours, Mr. Braggart!
lines.zh: 这个问题就交给你了，吹牛大王。

lines.en: Alright, I'll figure it out myself.
lines.zh: 好吧，我自己来搞定。

lines.en: Hey, Nolik!
lines.zh: 嘿，诺利克！

lines.en: Looks like you've got a problem!
lines.zh: 看来你遇到麻烦了。

lines.en: Oh, hi, Fire! Now I'm good. Just solving this Rubik's Cube.
lines.zh: 哦，嗨，火！是啊，没事，我只是在解魔方而已。

lines.en: Yeah? Can I do it with you? What?
lines.zh: 是啊，我可以和你一起做吗？你能做什么？

lines.en: You can do it? Of course I can!
lines.zh: 当然可以！

lines.en: How hard can it be?
lines.zh: 这能有多难？

lines.en: You'll see for yourself.
lines.zh: 你自己看看。

lines.en: Try getting all the red squares on one side.
lines.zh: 试试把所有的红色方块都放到一面

lines.en: Piece of cake! Now hold on tight, Nolik!
lines.zh: 小菜一碟。抓紧了。

lines.en: Great! I'm with you! Whoa!
lines.zh: 太好了，我跟你一起。

lines.en: You mean like that? Class! And what about this side?
lines.zh: 你是说像这样吗，同学们？呃，那这一面呢？

lines.en: What? This side's got to be all blue!
lines.zh: 这一面必须全是蓝色。

lines.en: OK, let's go fix it! There, like you wanted.
lines.zh: 好的，我们去把它弄好。音乐] 好了，就像你想要的那样。

lines.en: Now what happened to the red side?
lines.zh: 现在红色的那一面呢？

lines.en: Simka was telling me that on each side there has to be one color.
lines.zh: 嗯？辛科告诉我每一面都必须有一种颜色。哦

lines.en: Oh, like Simka would be able to do this?
lines.zh: 好像有些人能做到。

lines.en: Simka can do it all.
lines.zh: 辛卡可以做到。

lines.en: Well, if Simka can, then I can too.
lines.zh: 如果辛卡能做到，那 我也可以

lines.en: Fire! You busted the cube! I didn't bust it, I took it apart.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪，你把魔方弄坏了！我没弄坏它，我只是把它拆开了。

lines.en: Now let's put it together. And not just anyway, but the right way.
lines.zh: 现在让我们把它重新组装起来，而且要用正确的方法。

lines.en: Puzzles are toys, games, or problems that force you to use
lines.zh: 拼图是一种玩具、游戏或问题

lines.en: your mind in a clever and creative way.
lines.zh: 它能迫使你以巧妙和创造性的方式运用你的思维。

lines.en: Take a labyrinth, for example.
lines.zh: 以

lines.en: In a labyrinth the challenge is to find the
lines.zh: 迷宫为例，在迷宫中

lines.en: one way to get through a series of tangled corridors.
lines.zh: 挑战在于找到穿过一系列错综复杂走廊的唯一路径。

lines.en: Another fun puzzle is a jigsaw puzzle.
lines.zh: 另一个有趣的拼图是拼图游戏

lines.en: Here you need to put together a picture out of many little pieces.
lines.zh: 你需要将许多小碎片拼成一幅完整的图画。

lines.en: For this you need to not only pay attention, but be patient.
lines.zh: 为此，你不仅需要集中注意力

lines.en: And there are all sorts of puzzles for the computer.
lines.zh: 还需要耐心。电脑上也有很多种拼图游戏。

lines.en: One popular computer puzzle is Tetris. In Tetris,
lines.zh: 一种流行的电脑拼图游戏是俄罗斯方块。在俄罗斯方块中

lines.en: different shapes fall down the screen,
lines.zh: 不同形状的方块会从屏幕上掉落

lines.en: and you have to think quickly to get them to line up into rows.
lines.zh: 你必须快速思考才能将它们排列成行。

lines.en: And solving puzzles isn't only a great activity for people.
lines.zh: 解谜不仅对人类来说是一项很棒的活动

lines.en: It's good for Fixies too! That's right! Puzzles are like exercises for our brain!
lines.zh: 对骑固定齿轮自行车的人来说也很有好处。没错，拼图就像是锻炼我们大脑的练习。

lines.en: There! All done!
lines.zh: 都完成了！

lines.en: Nolik, you better hurry, because Tom Thomas is on his way home!
lines.zh: 你最好快点，因为汤姆·托马斯正在回家的路上。

lines.en: Hi there, Simka!
lines.zh: 嗨，辛卡

lines.en: Just take a look at this!
lines.zh: 就…… 看看这个

lines.en: We did it! I can't believe it! How?
lines.zh: 我们做到了！我简直不敢相信！怎么做到的？哦，简直易如反掌！

lines.en: Oh, it was a piece of cake! Simka!
lines.zh: 辛卡，别舔！

lines.en: Nolik! I'm back! Well, I'm out of here!
lines.zh: 我回来了！好了，我走了

lines.en: Ciao! Wow! You really solved it!
lines.zh: 再见！哇，你真的解开了！真的

lines.en: It was Nolik! Nolik, you are cool! So how?
lines.zh: 一点都不难！你太酷了！

lines.en: You see, first you break it apart into all of the
lines.zh: 你看，你先把它拆成所有碎片

lines.en: pieces and then you put it all back together.
lines.zh: 然后再把它们拼起来。不

lines.en: No! That's cheating!
lines.zh: 那是作弊！

lines.en: You've got to turn the cube, not take it apart.
lines.zh: 你得转动魔方，而不是把它拆开。

lines.en: Now I'll solve this cube, honestly.
lines.zh: 现在我要解开这个魔方了！说实话

lines.en: I don't think you can.
lines.zh: 我觉得你解不开！

lines.en: Why are you so sure?
lines.zh: 你怎么这么肯定？

lines.en: I glued it together. How come?
lines.zh: 我把它粘起来了！啊，怎么会这样？

lines.en: So you'll stop straining your brain with it.
lines.zh: 这样你就不用再费脑筋了！

lines.en: Now the cube will always be the right way.
lines.zh: 现在魔方永远都是正确的方向

lines.en: But if it doesn't turn, it's not a Rubik's Cube.
lines.zh: 但如果它转不动，那就不是魔方了！

lines.en: Well, yeah. Now it's a Nolik's Cube, right?
lines.zh: 嗯，现在它是诺莱克斯魔方了，对吧？

lines.en: They take care of our machines, irons, phones, and toasters, MP3s and TV screens.
lines.zh: 它们负责维护我们的机器：熨斗、手机、烤面包机、电视屏幕，甚至过山车。
